stemMd: What is the complete real solution set of $(x-2)/(x+1)>0$?
explanationMd: The fraction is positive when numerator and denominator have the same sign. Both are negative for x<−1 and positive for x>2. Strict positivity excludes the zero at 2 and undefined point −1.

distractorRationale.b: The pole and zero must be excluded.
distractorRationale.e: The numerator and denominator have opposite signs there.
distractorRationale.a: This includes invalid and negative-ratio values.
